grownups.heading: For grown-ups
grownups.language.heading: Language
grownups.language.label: Language of the grown-ups’ area
grownups.language.note: The children’s game is always in Czech. The grown-ups’ area can be in Czech or in English.
grownups.settings.none: Once children make their profiles in the game, you will find each child’s settings here.
grownups.settings.failed: The settings could not be saved.
grownups.voice.heading: Reading aloud
grownups.voice.available: The game reads aloud only with Czech voices that run on this device itself. No text is sent anywhere.
grownups.voice.none: This device has no Czech voice that runs on the device itself. So the game does not read aloud, and children do not see the read-aloud button. Everything else works.
grownups.voice.howTo: To add a Czech voice: on iPad and iPhone it is the voice Zuzana (Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices › Czech). On Windows, add Czech in Settings › Time & language › Speech. Then open the game again.
grownups.data.backupIntro: When a browser runs out of space, it may delete the game’s data. A backup saves one child’s progress to a file, which you can load back later, even on another device.
grownups.data.none: There are no children here yet.
grownups.data.exportFailed: The backup could not be made: {name}
grownups.data.importConfirmBody: The backup replaces the child’s current progress and settings. To keep them, save a backup first.
grownups.data.importFailed: This file cannot be loaded. It is not a Pearl Sea backup, or it is damaged.
grownups.data.resetBody: Pearls, sea friends and coins are erased for good. The settings stay.
grownups.data.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
grownups.data.persisted: The browser promised to keep the game’s data.
grownups.data.notPersisted: When the browser runs out of space, it may delete the game’s data. You can ask it to keep them.
grownups.data.persistUnknown: The browser does not say whether it keeps the game’s data.
grownups.offline.heading: Playing offline
grownups.offline.intro: Install the game on this device. Then it works without an internet connection too.
grownups.offline.ready: The game is installed and works offline.
grownups.offline.missing: The game is not installed for offline play yet.
grownups.offline.unavailable: This browser cannot install the game, so it needs an internet connection.
grownups.offline.updateReady: A new version is downloaded. It is used the next time you open the game.
grownups.offline.failed: The installation did not work (code {code}). Please try again.
grownups.about.privacy: The game sends nothing to the internet: no accounts, ads or tracking. Children’s names and progress stay on this device only.
grownups.about.font: The Pearl Reading font is based on Andika (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
grownups.gate.heading: For grown-ups only
grownups.gate.holdHint: Press and hold the lock for two seconds.
grownups.gate.question: What is {a} × {b}?
grownups.gate.wrong: That is not right. Here is another one.
grownups.keypad.label: Number pad
grownups.recovery.heading: The saved data cannot be opened
grownups.recovery.family: The list of children on this device cannot be read.
grownups.recovery.game: The saved game cannot be opened: {name}
grownups.recovery.content: The saved game needs an older version of the game’s content, which is not available right now. Connect to the internet and try opening it again.
grownups.recovery.unchanged: Nothing was changed or deleted. Choose what to do next.
grownups.recovery.unavailable: The browser does not allow reading the saved data right now. Try again, or close and reopen the browser.
grownups.recovery.export: Save the original data to a file
grownups.recovery.previous: Go back to the previous saved copy
grownups.recovery.resetBody: This saved data will be erased for good.
grownups.recovery.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
grownups.print.guidance.duplex: Print on both sides, flipping on the long edge, at actual size (100%) and without the browser’s headers and footers. Try one sheet first.
grownups.print.guidance.single: Print at actual size (100%) without the browser’s headers and footers.
grownups.divers.removeBody: This erases the child’s whole game progress and settings. It cannot be undone.
grownups.progress.noGame: The game is still being built. Progress will show here once it can be played.
grownups.progress.none: Once children make their profiles in the game, you will see their progress here.
grownups.progress.goalsNote: Mastered means pearls the child knows reliably: silver and gold.
grownups.progress.hardest: Where the child goes wrong most
grownups.progress.diplomasNone: A child earns a diploma for each monster freed and for each whole grade.
grownups.progress.printFailed: The printout could not be prepared.
grownups.game.heading: The game
grownups.game.gradeNote: The grade sets where the child starts and what the game suggests. Finished levels stay.
grownups.game.gradeNotServed: The game does not cover this grade yet.
grownups.game.gradeBusy: The grade cannot change during the placement check. Try again after it.
